card.name: Spot before a metric measurement
card.fires_on: The gap just before a number given in metric or SI units, often after an alternative unit like mg/dL, mCi or feet. It fires where a metric value such as micromol/L, MBq, metres or mmol/L is about to be written.

modes.description: The point before an SI-unit equivalent follows a conventional-unit value in parentheses.

modes.label: Lengths and heights in metres
modes.description: The point before a length, height or depth in metres or centimetres in general text.
modes.example: Tuvalu sits just<< four>> metres above sea level.

card.writes: It pushes toward metric unit words like meter, kg and mm and away from imperial ones like feet, inches and pounds.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a metric measurement is about to appear, not feet, inches or pounds.
